newsitem.title: USA: Torotel says Brockson to buy majority of shares.
newsitem.headline: Torotel says Brockson to buy majority of shares.

text.p: Torotel Inc said Friday it has entered a definitive agreement to sell 2.2 million newly issued shares of common stock to Brockson Technologies Group Llc for about $2.2 million.
Brockson has also agreed to buy an additional 510,506 shares of the company from the founder's family, giving it more than 50 percent of the outstanding shares of the company, Torotel said.

Phoenix-based Brockson also will receive additional shares of common stock for no further cost if switching power supplies manufacturer Torotel experiences any extraordinary costs or expenses related to recently disclosed product testing failures, Torotel said.
The deal is expected to close in the second quarter of this year, Torotel chief financial officer Jim Serrone said in an interview.
Torotel shares were up 2/16 at 1-3/16 Friday.
